abilities.name: Barkskin
abilities.desc: Your skin becomes as tough as bark. Physical damage taken is reduced by 20%. While you are protected, damaging attacks will not cause spellcasting delays. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Entangling Roots
abilities.desc: Roots the target in place and causes 234 Nature damage over 27 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. You may only have 1 target Rooted at a time.

abilities.name: Faerie Fire
abilities.desc: Decrease the armor of the target by 505 for 40 sec. While affected, the target cannot stealth or turn invisible.

abilities.name: Hibernate
abilities.desc: Forces the enemy target to sleep for up to 40 sec. Any damage will awaken the target. Only one target can be forced to hibernate at a time. Only works on Beasts and Dragonkin.

abilities.name: Hurricane
abilities.desc: Creates a violent storm in the target area causing 132 Nature damage to enemies every 1 sec, and increasing the time between attacks by 20%. Lasts 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

abilities.name: Insect Swarm
abilities.desc: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by 2% and causing 186 Nature damage over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Moonfire
abilities.desc: Burns the enemy for 128 to 150 Arcane damage and then an additional 240 Arcane damage over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Moonkin Form
abilities.desc:
Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing Omen of Clarity's chance to trigger by 100%, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and all party or raid members within 45 yards have their spell Critical Strike chance increased by 3%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and prevents the use of healing spells.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Nature's Grasp
abilities.desc: The next 1 melee attack that strikes the caster will afflict the attacker with Entangling Roots (Rank 6). Castable while shapeshifted. Lasts 45 sec.

abilities.name: Soothe Animal
abilities.desc: Soothes the target beast, reducing the range at which it will attack you by 10 yards. Only affects Beast targets level 70 or lower. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Starfire
abilities.desc: Causes 350 to 412 Arcane damage to the target.

abilities.name: Teleport: Moonglade
abilities.desc: Teleports the caster to the Moonglade.

abilities.name: Thorns
abilities.desc: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 18 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 10 min.

abilities.name: Wrath
abilities.desc: Causes 92 to 102 Nature damage to the target.

abilities.name: Aquatic Form
abilities.desc:
Shapeshift into Aquatic Form, increasing swim speed by 50% and allowing the druid to breathe underwater. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Bash
lines: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
abilities.desc: Stuns the target for 4 sec.

abilities.name: Bear Form
abilities.desc:
Shapeshift into Bear Form, increasing Attack Power by 120, Armor contribution from items by 180%, and Health by 180. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Berserk
lines: Requires Cat Form, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
abilities.desc: Causes your Primal Bite ability to strike up to 3 targets, removes its cooldown, and increases the critical strike chance of your Combo Point-generating abilities by 100%. Clears and grants immunity to Fear effects for the duration. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Cat Form
abilities.desc:
Shapeshift into Cat Form, increasing Attack Power by 120 plus Agility. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various cat abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Challenging Roar
lines: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
abilities.desc: Forces all nearby enemies to focus attacks on you for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.desc: Claw the enemy for 110% normal damage plus 126. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Cower
abilities.desc: Cower, causing no damage but lowering your threat a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

abilities.name: Dash
abilities.desc: Increases movement speed by 60% for 15 sec. Does not break prowling.

abilities.name: Demoralizing Roar
lines: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
abilities.desc: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' melee attack power by 204. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Dire Bear Form
abilities.desc:
Shapeshift into Dire Bear Form, increasing Attack Power by 180, Armor contribution from items by 360%, and Health by 1,240. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and allows the use of various bear abilities.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Enrage
lines: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
abilities.desc: Instantly generates 10 Rage and another 20 Rage over 10 sec, but reduces base armor by 27% in Bear Form and 16% in Dire Bear Form. The druid is considered in combat for the duration.

abilities.name: Feral Charge
lines: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
abilities.desc:
Charge an enemy, immobilizing them and interrupting any spell they are casting for 4 sec.

Feral Charge (Cat): 8-25 yd range, Instant, 30 sec cooldown, Requires Cat Form. Leap behind an enemy.

abilities.name: Ferocious Bite
abilities.desc:
Finishing move that causes damage per combo point and converts each extra point of energy into 2.7 additional damage. Damage is increased by your Attack Power.
 1 point : 199-259 damage
 2 points: 346-406 damage
 3 points: 493-553 damage
 4 points: 640-700 damage
 5 points: 787-847 damage

abilities.name: Frenzied Regeneration
lines: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
abilities.desc: Converts up to 10 Rage per second into health for 10 sec. Each point of Rage is converted into 1% health.

abilities.name: Growl
lines: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
abilities.desc: Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

abilities.name: Lacerate
lines: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
abilities.desc: Lacerates the enemy target, making them bleed for 75 damage over 15 sec plus 10% weapon damage per existing application of Lacerate on the target. Causes a high amount of threat. This effect stacks up to 5 times on the same target.

abilities.name: Maul
lines: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
abilities.desc: Increases the druid's next attack by 128 damage.

abilities.name: Pounce
abilities.desc: Pounce, stunning the target for 2 sec and causing 150 damage over 18 sec. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Primal Bite
lines: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
abilities.desc: Bite the target, dealing 100% normal damage plus 77 and generating a high amount of threat.

abilities.name: Prowl
abilities.desc: Allows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 30%. Lasts until cancelled.

abilities.name: Rake
abilities.desc: Rake the target for 61 damage and an additional 102 damage over 9 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Ravage
abilities.desc: Ravage the target, causing 350% damage plus 343 to the target. Must be prowling and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Rip
abilities.desc:
Finishing move that causes damage over time. Damage increases per combo point and by your Attack Power:
 1 point : 243 damage over 12 sec.
 2 points: 396 damage over 12 sec.
 3 points: 549 damage over 12 sec.
 4 points: 702 damage over 12 sec.
 5 points: 855 damage over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Shifting Power
abilities.desc: Instantly convert 55% of base Mana into 40 Energy. Shifting Power's cost is reduced by effects that reduce the cost of Shapeshifting.

abilities.name: Shred
abilities.desc: Shred the target, causing 155% damage plus 124 to the target. Must be behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

abilities.name: Swipe
lines: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
abilities.desc: Swipe 3 nearby enemies, inflicting 83 damage.

abilities.name: Track Humanoids
abilities.desc: Shows the location of all nearby humanoids on the minimap. Only one type of thing can be tracked at a time.

abilities.name: Travel Form
abilities.desc:
Shapeshift into Travel Form, increasing movement speed by 40%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects. Only useable outdoors.

The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

abilities.name: Abolish Poison
abilities.desc: Attempts to cure 1 poison effect on the target, and 1 more poison effect every 2 seconds for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Cure Poison
abilities.desc: Cures 1 poison effect on the target.

abilities.name: Gift of the Wild
abilities.desc: Gives the Gift of the Wild to all party and raid members, increasing armor by 385, all attributes by 16 and all resistances by 27 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Healing Touch
abilities.desc: Heals a friendly target for 2,139 to 2,525.

abilities.name: Innervate
abilities.desc: Increases the target's Mana regeneration by 400% and allows 100% of the target's Mana regeneration to continue while casting. Lasts 20 sec.

abilities.name: Mark of the Wild
abilities.desc: Increases the friendly target's armor by 385, all attributes by 16 and all resistances by 27 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Nature's Swiftness
abilities.desc: When activated, your next Nature spell becomes an instant cast spell.

abilities.name: Rebirth
abilities.desc: Returns the spirit to the body, restoring a dead target to life with 2,200 health and 2800 mana.

abilities.name: Regrowth
abilities.desc: Heals a friendly target for 965 to 1,077 and another 994 over 21 sec.

abilities.name: Rejuvenation
abilities.desc: Heals the target for 776 over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Remove Curse
abilities.desc: Dispels 1 Curse or Bane from a friendly target.

abilities.name: Revive
abilities.desc: Brings a dead player back to life with 750 health and 1000 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.

abilities.name: Swiftmend
abilities.desc: Instantly heals a target with an active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of one of those spells.

abilities.name: Tranquility
abilities.desc: Regenerates all nearby party members within 20 yards for 285 every 2 sec for 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

abilities.name: Wild Growth
abilities.desc: Heals the target and their party for 679 over 7 sec. Party members must be within 43 yds of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.

abilities.name: War Stomp
abilities.desc: Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.

abilities.name: Cultivation
abilities.desc: Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once. In play it goes on a 15 min cooldown, though its tooltip shows none.

abilities.name: Walk on Air
abilities.desc: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

abilities.name: Skysight
abilities.desc: Increases your movement speed by 15% for 15 sec. Used at an elemental convergence it also grants Charged for 1 hour, which raises the bonus to 30%. Charged persists through death and ends when you enter a raid.

abilities.name: Shadowmeld
abilities.desc: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.

abilities.name: Elune's Light
abilities.desc: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Walk on Air
abilities.desc: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

abilities.name: Read Leyline
abilities.desc: Increases your Health and Mana regeneration by 50% for 15 sec. Used at a Ley Line it also grants Attuned for 1 hour, which raises the bonus to 100%. Attuned persists through death and ends when you enter a raid. Cannot be used while Innervate is active.
